roleLabel: Area Burn Mage — range-wide Wildfire that turns Burn ticks into Magic and Mana
bestFor: Burn/Mage boards that want every enemy in range cooking at once
strength: Wildfire hits all enemies in range with damage + Burn; Stoked converts their Burn damage into team Magic and his Mana
weakness: Needs enemies to stay in range and Burn to actually tick — short fights or empty range feel awful

howToPlay.early: Draft when you can protect a backline Mage. Magic matters, but range and survivability decide if Wildfire ever hits the full pack.
howToPlay.mid: Stoked = Mage Burn engine (team Magic + his Mana). Inferno = more range and Stall/start Burn application. Detonator = cast forces Burn ticks immediately. Pick sustain Burn economy, wider zone, or burst detonate.
howToPlay.late: Stack Magic and Burn relics. Keep him alive through cast cycles; dead Funke stops the whole Burn loop.
howToPlay.positioning: Back-mid with the widest view of the pack. Inferno especially wants max enemies in range — do not tuck him in a blind corner.

abilityNotes.Wildfire: Full-range nuke + Burn. Value scales with how many targets share his range — formation and Attack Range matter as much as Magic.

specNotes.The Stoked: Default Mage Burn engine — every Burn tick in range feeds Magic/Mana. Best with other Mages sharing the Backup.
specNotes.The Inferno: Take when packs are wide or you need Stall/start Burn coverage beyond one cast.
specNotes.The Detonator: Take for burst: casts slam stored Burn ticks. Better when fights are short or bosses need a pop.

relicReasons.mages-elemental-banner-595: Elemental/Burn identity for the Mage tag.
relicReasons.mages-cataclysm-engine-4006: AoE Mage engine that matches Wildfire’s full-range fantasy.
relicReasons.arcane-amplifier-2014: Raw Magic amp when class pieces are missing.

faq.question: Is Funke good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Yes on Burn boards with protected casting. No if he never sees more than one enemy or dies before Wildfire. Shop check: do you have a front line?

faq.question: What class is Funke?
faq.answer: Mage. Role focus: area Burn caster who scales when enemies in range take Burn damage.

faq.question: What relics work with Funke?
faq.answer: Mage Elemental/Cataclysm pieces, Arcane amplifiers, and Burn enablers.

faq.question: How do you play Funke?
faq.answer: Protect him, maximize enemies in range, cast Wildfire, and specialize toward Stoked economy, Inferno coverage, or Detonator burst.

tips: If only one mob is in range, move the tank or Funke — more Magic will not fix geometry.
Stoked wants Burn to tick; pair DoT duration or Detonator when ticks are too slow.
